invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of JavaBulkInsertHelper.bulkInsert, which is expected to be non-null.
The result is directly returned as List<WriteStatus>; ensures type conformance.
Method would fail early if inputRecords were null, as it is passed to bulkInsert.
Parallelism (numOutputGroups) for clustering should logically be positive.
strategyParams is passed to getPartitioner; a null map would likely cause failure.
